<u>**Data Science/Bioinformatics Learning Objectives:**</u>

1. Discuss ways in which containerization promotes reproduciblity within collaborative scientific research.
1. Describe how containerization is one of several tools to support the process of increasing the reproducibility of scientific research.
1. Employ multiple reproducibility best practices together within the context of containerization.
1. Evaluate what should or should not be included in a container.
1. Identify contexts where containerization (potentially with Docker) is not appropriate or needed.
1. Practice the containerization process to reproduce, extend, and share a data analysis.
1. Verify that analysis results or outputs match expectations.
